title: Biome chests and hardmode keys in the dungeon vault
player_outcome: The dungeon's deepest vault holds six ornate locked chests: Jungle, Corruption, Crimson, Hallowed, Frozen and Desert. Each opens only after Plantera falls, with a key that drops (1 in 2500) from hardmode enemies in its biome.
design: Objects: jungle_chest, corruption_chest, crimson_chest, hallowed_chest, frozen_chest, desert_chest. Each has lock {key <biome>_key, requiresFlag defeated_plantera, message 'It can only be opened once Plantera is defeated.'} and tags [world]. Models use the chest generator with themed params (vines, eyes, flesh, crystal, ice, sandstone).
Keys: jungle_key, corruption_key, crimson_key, hallowed_key, frozen_key, desert_key (key generator variants).
global_kill additions: each key chance 0.0004 with conditions [flag hardmode, biome any [<biome>]] (jungle includes underground_jungle; desert includes underground_desert).
Loot tables '<biome>_chest': the single P4-33 weapon.
DungeonDecorator vault: place all six chests Locked on the reserved spots.
tests: LockedChestTests.BiomeChestsWaitForPlantera: refused without the flag even with a key; opened with the flag and key.
Smoke dungeon.cmds: 'tp landmark dungeon_bottom', 'wait_until stream.idle == 1 600', 'interact nearest jungle_chest 12' (refused).
risks: Vault placement in Tiny worlds must fit six chests. The planner already sizes the vault room at ≥ 14×14.
